documents.title: Vector search index tuning
documents.content: HNSW build parameters matter less than the recall target suggests. The ef_construction value drives build cost linearly, while ef_search dominates query latency. Measure on a held-out query set before choosing, not on random samples.

documents.title: Embedding model selection
documents.content: The BGE family strikes a practical balance between retrieval quality and throughput. Int8 quantization trims memory by a factor of four with negligible recall loss on most English corpora. Always benchmark with your own data.

documents.title: Chunk size heuristics
documents.content: Short chunks improve precision but lose surrounding context. Long chunks carry context but dilute the embedding. A section-aware chunker that prepends headings often outperforms both fixed-window and naive sentence splitters.

documents.title: Metadata promotion
documents.content: Promoting JSONB metadata into typed columns pays off when you filter frequently on the same key. Postgres can use a btree index on the promoted column and skip the JSONB path extraction overhead entirely.

documents.title: Evaluation harnesses
documents.content: A small gold question set beats a large noisy one. Thirty hand-labeled queries produce stable rankings across chunker and embedder variants. Automate the harness so re-running takes minutes, not hours.
